pages.text: If you suddenly have Weakness or Mining Fatigue, it's probably radiation.$(br)1. Get the $(l)Geiger Counter$() from its quest. It fits in a bauble slot.$(br)2. Use it to find a spot with low radiation.
3. Eat $(l)golden food$() (golden carrots, golden apples, enchanted apples) to lower your accumulated dose.

$(l)How radiation works:$()$(li)You have an accumulated $(l)dose$() (the bar, max 1000 Rads; bad effects start around 500) and a current $(l)rate$() (Rads/t).$(li)Golden food lowers your dose but not your rate. If you keep receiving radiation, you'll have to keep eating.
$(li)nRads/t (nano) is background noise. A few µRads/t (micro) is fine. Dozens of µRads/t, or anything in mRads/t (milli), means a wasteland is nearby: move.

$(li)Radiation flows from loaded chunks into neighbouring chunks, so being near a wasteland slowly raises the level around your base.$(li)Radioactive items in your inventory, on the floor or in $(l)vanilla chests$() also leak radiation. Most other storage blocks are safe.
$(li)Scrubbers lower radiation, but next to a wasteland they only treat the symptoms.$(li)The Void world copies Overworld biomes, so a wasteland there still emits radiation.
